llmConfiguration.claudeCliNote: Runs the Claude Code CLI installed and signed in on this machine, so no API key is needed here. Claude Code still sends your prompts to Anthropic through your account.
llmConfiguration.claudeCliModelHint: Each alias runs the newest model in its family. Your Claude plan decides which ones you can use.
llmConfiguration.claudeCliWarning: Anthropic doesn't allow third-party apps to route requests through Claude Free, Pro or Max plans, and this option may count as one. Anthropic can enforce that without notice; for guaranteed access, use an Anthropic API key. Resume Matcher never sees or stores your Claude credentials: it runs your own Claude Code CLI, which you sign in to yourself with `claude auth login`. Requests count toward your Claude plan's usage limits, and Anthropic may draw them from usage credits instead.
llmConfiguration.agentName: Your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Copilot)
llmConfiguration.agentNote: Your coding agent does the AI work: it reads your resume and job descriptions, writes tailored versions and saves them here with the resume-matcher command. The app makes no AI calls of its own, so its AI buttons give you a prompt to paste into your agent.
llmConfiguration.chatgptWarning: This uses OpenAI's official Sign in with ChatGPT for open-source apps, which is a preview and may change. It works with ChatGPT Plus and Pro. Requests go from your machine directly to OpenAI's API, and the sign-in tokens stay encrypted on this machine. Usage counts toward your ChatGPT plan's limits: on Plus, the five-hour limit is shared with your other apps that use your plan; Pro has no five-hour limit. For guaranteed access, use an OpenAI API key.
llmConfiguration.apiKeyOptionalPlaceholder: Leave blank if your server has no auth
llmConfiguration.leaveBlankToKeepExistingKey: LEAVE BLANK TO KEEP EXISTING KEY
llmConfiguration.baseUrlDescription: Override the API base URL to use a proxy/aggregator endpoint. Leave blank to use provider default.
llmConfiguration.azureBaseUrlDescription: Paste the endpoint from Foundry. GPT deployments can use the service root or /openai/v1/responses; Azure AI Inference models can use the /models endpoint.

llmConfiguration.reasoningEffortDescription: Only affects reasoning-capable models (gpt-5 family, Claude 3.7+, DeepSeek R1, OpenAI o1/o3). Unsupported providers drop this value automatically.

agentPrompt.instructions: Paste this prompt into your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Copilot) running in the Resume Matcher folder. The agent does the AI work and saves the result here.
agentPrompt.refresh: This page updates on its own as your agent saves its work.
agentPrompt.tailorPageMessage: Your coding agent tailors resumes in agent mode. Paste the job description below, then copy the prompt for your agent.
agentPrompt.queuePageMessage: In agent mode, your coding agent handles batches. Save each job description as a .md or .txt file in the jobs/ folder, then ask your agent to tailor your resume for every job there.

createMaster.title: Create your master resume
createMaster.prompt: Use Resume Matcher to create my master resume from this file: <path to your resume PDF or DOCX>. If I don't have a resume file, ask me questions and build one with me.

tailor.title: Tailor your resume
tailor.prompt:
Use Resume Matcher to tailor my master resume to this job:

<paste the job description here>
tailor.promptWithJob:
Use Resume Matcher to tailor resume {resumeId} to this job:

{job}
tailor.note: Several jobs? Save each description as a .md or .txt file in the jobs/ folder and ask your agent to tailor your resume for every job there. Each one appears on the dashboard.

enhance.title: Enhance your resume
enhance.prompt: Use Resume Matcher to improve the bullet points in resume {resumeId}. Ask me about results, numbers and tools I left out, then update the resume with my answers. Don't add anything I didn't tell you.

regenerate.title: Rewrite with your agent
regenerate.prompt: Use Resume Matcher to rewrite <which experience, projects or skills> in resume {resumeId}: <what to improve>. Keep every fact true and show me the changes before you save them.

coverLetter.title: Write a cover letter
coverLetter.prompt: Use Resume Matcher to write a cover letter for resume {resumeId}, for the job it was tailored to, and save it to that resume.

outreach.title: Write an outreach message
outreach.prompt: Use Resume Matcher to write a short outreach message to the hiring manager for the job resume {resumeId} was tailored to, and save it to that resume.

interviewPrep.title: Prepare for the interview
interviewPrep.prompt: Use Resume Matcher to read resume {resumeId} and the job it was tailored to, then help me prepare for the interview: likely questions, the stories to tell and questions to ask them.
interviewPrep.note: Your agent answers in its own chat. In agent mode, interview prep is not saved to the resume.

improveWriting.title: Improve the writing
improveWriting.prompt: Use Resume Matcher to improve the writing of resume {resumeId}: run two writing rounds (critique every line against the rubric, rewrite the weak ones keeping every fact, verify), then save.
